caption:
Your slow season isn’t a season. It’s a calendar.

Every year it feels like demand disappears and comes back on its own. It doesn’t. It just moves earlier than you do.

Homeowners start picturing the yard long before the grass grows. By the time they call, the shortlist is already made — and whoever was visible during that window takes the whole season.

Ask your last five clients one question. Not "when did you call me". Ask: when did you first start thinking about getting this done? The gap between those two answers is the window you’re not in.

That’s the window we work. A season gets won in the eight weeks nobody is advertising.

Comment your city and I'll check how you show up — where you land, who's above you, and what they're doing that you're not. No charge, no call.

Follow @davis.mkt for more ways to fill your calendar.
